All 17 example cases pass with `node check.mjs`, and large inputs run fast: wordfreq takes about 0.11–0.16 s on 50 MB inputs, including random binary bytes, and lru takes about 0.07 s for a million commands. I also checked calc's 64-bit edge cases by hand: the minimum-value cases, multiplication overflow, `% -1` and 100,000 nested parentheses all give the results the spec requires.

The code is in `main.go`, `wordfreq.go`, `lru.go` and `calc.go`, and `build.sh` builds the optimized binary
